author: bono
verdict_summary: 4 PASS + 1 PARTIAL (Q3 WhatsApp delivery — pre-existing surface limitation reused not modified; NOT a blocker per §S-186 PARTIAL-acceptable doctrine for surface-reuse-without-modification class)

questions.surface_under_check: TSDB metric emission + audit_log SELECT query path + admin endpoint handler
questions.rationale: TSDB MetricsSender.try_send is non-blocking atomic channel send (drops on full channel — acceptable observability semantic). audit_log SELECT is read-only idempotent SQL. Admin handler uses standard axum State+Query extractors with single-shot DB query (no multi-step transaction). All primitives are atomic at their semantic level.

questions.topic: TTL-bounded sentinels integrated with the atomic primitive
questions.surface_under_check: TSDB ring buffer + rollups + alert task cooldown
questions.rationale: metrics_samples 7-day retention (Phase 285 doctrine); metrics_rollups 90-day daily resolution; metric_alert_task per-rule 30-min cooldown built-in (metric_alerts.rs:23 'let cooldown = Duration::from_secs(30 * 60)'). All bounds explicit and TTL-enforced. Cooldown integrates with the atomic try_send pattern via the snapshot-then-evaluate cycle (60s tick + 30-min last_fired tracking).

WhatsApp send via Evolution API is best-effort fire-and-forget per existing whatsapp_alerter.rs (no end-to-end ACK from Uday's device). Alert firing IS audit-trailed (event_archive.append_event 'alert.fired' per metric_alerts.rs:95). So firing is verified; delivery is echo-only (HTTP 200 from Evolution API ≠ message-delivered-to-Uday). Sibling Q3 surface to §S-263 deploy-surface verification. PR REUSES this surface; does NOT modify it. Pre-existing PATCHED-ONLY disposition per RCA §3.
questions.remediation: Phase γ follow-up: separate PR adds retry+ACK+fallback to send_whatsapp surface. Out of this PR's scope per smallest-reversible-change principle.

questions.surface_under_check: Daily-clamp producer + admin endpoint + alert eval
questions.rationale: Daily-clamp producer is single-target (no fleet broadcast); admin endpoint is single-host query (uses local state.db only). Alert eval is single-rule against snapshot. No multi-pod fan-out. No fleet-wide blast surface. Dry-run path: run binary in dev with mock alert_rules; verify producer emits sample; verify metric_alert_task does NOT call send_whatsapp when count <= threshold.

questions.topic: guards have written contracts with delivery script (parser-not-regex + allowlist)
questions.rationale: metric_alert_task consumes typed MetricAlertRule struct from config (not stringly-parsed eval). AlertCondition is a typed enum (Gt | Lt | Eq) parsed via serde from TOML. Schema is documented in config.rs MetricAlertRule. No regex; no string-eval. Allowlist semantic: only metrics that exist in TSDB snapshot are evaluated (metric_alerts.rs:47-55 — 'metric not in snapshot, skipping rule').
